card.text: Explore Kiviuq, a moon of Saturn, through its lightcurve-constrained shape approximation.

introduction.text: Kiviuq belongs to Saturn’s Inuit group of outer moons. This ellipsoid illustrates a lightcurve-based minimum elongation, with assumed depth and orientation. The grid marks unmapped terrain.

model.title: Light-curve shape approximation
model.summary: Approximate ellipsoid adopting the published minimum equatorial ratio 2.32:1 under uniform reflectivity. Equal short axes, volume scaling and orientation are assumed. The grid marks unmapped terrain.
